notes: Phase 2 is the switch, and reading condition-eval.evaluate BEFORE touching it found why it could not be one step. evaluate reads FOUR things its operators produce as SIDE EFFECTS on the evaluation context — the per-leaf legs, the open sequence partials, the live absent timers, and the window notes — and a naive switch would have lost THREE OF THE FOUR. The series would have been right and the tick would have gone quiet about every open sequence, every live timer and every still-open session; state would have stopped reporting partial at all, which is a firing-adjacent fact the accrual record c
